question: Should runtime/gateway localization be allowed to make gateway JSON message/reason fields locale-dependent, or should protocol-facing JSON text remain stable while only display surfaces are localized?
rationale: The code can be repaired mechanically for authMode billing copy, but the gateway field contract is a product/API boundary choice that affects existing clients and cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Keep JSON Text Stable
options.body: Localize channel/TUI/display copy while preserving gateway JSON message/reason text or adding separate localized display fields; this is the safest compatibility path.

options.title: Allow Localized Display Fields
options.body: Accept locale-dependent gateway message/reason fields if maintainers explicitly define code/type fields as the stable client contract and add upgrade-proof tests/docs.

options.title: Pause Runtime Localization
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it only after maintainers decide that runtime i18n should wait for a broader localization architecture.

recommendation.title: Keep JSON Text Stable
recommendation.body: Localize channel/TUI/display copy while preserving gateway JSON message/reason text or adding separate localized display fields; this is the safest compatibility path.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the adjacent billing-copy contract and previously handled the broader i18n direction discussion, making them the best available owner for the compatibility/product choice.
